labs.title: Vernier Caliper Cylinder Metrology
labs.goal: Measure the cylinder's outer diameter D, inner diameter d, and length H, in millimeters.

labs.title: Convex Lens Focal Length
labs.goal: Measure the focal length f of the converging lens, in millimeters. Submit {"action":"answer","f":number}.

labs.title: Concave Lens Negative Focal Length
labs.goal: Measure the signed focal length of the concave lens. Submit {f} in millimetres.

labs.title: Lens Autocollimation
labs.zhTitle: 凸透镜自准直测前焦距
labs.goal: Measure the front focal distance of the lens from its entrance vertex. Submit {"action":"answer","f":number} in millimetres.

labs.title: Polarizer Axis & Extinction Ratio
labs.zhTitle: 偏振器透振轴偏移与消光比
labs.goal: Measure the relative transmission-axis offset theta0 of the two polarizer mounts (degrees modulo 180) and the analyzer extinction ratio r (dimensionless). Submit {"action":"answer","theta0":number,"r":number}.

labs.title: Wheatstone Bridge Null Resistance
labs.goal: Measure the resistance of the unknown resistor, in ohms. Submit {"action":"answer","R":number}.

labs.title: Four-Wire Kelvin Low Resistance
labs.goal: Measure the specimen resistance and the combined series resistance of the two force leads. Submit {"action":"answer","R":number,"R_leads":number}, both in milliohms.

labs.title: Simple Pendulum Gravity
labs.zhTitle: 外星单摆测重力加速度
labs.goal: Measure the gravitational acceleration on this unfamiliar planet, in m/s². Submit {"action":"answer","g":number}.

labs.title: Viscous Pendulum Damping
labs.goal: Measure the pendulum's viscous damping coefficient γ in s⁻¹, defined by the drag force −mγv. Submit {"action":"answer","gamma":number}.

labs.title: Micrometer Screw Fine Wire
labs.zhTitle: 螺旋测微器测细丝直径
labs.goal: Measure the diameter of the wire, in millimeters. Submit {"action":"answer","D":number}.

labs.title: Slide-Wire Potentiometer EMF
labs.goal: Measure the electromotive force of the unknown cell, in volts. Submit {"action":"answer","E":number}.

labs.title: Oscilloscope Signal Capture
labs.goal: Measure the unknown signal's frequency (Hz), peak-to-peak voltage (V), and DC offset (V); submit {f,Vpp,offset}.

labs.title: XY Lissajous Frequency Ratio
labs.goal: Measure the frequencies of the three output settings on source A. Submit {f1,f2,f3} in Hz in selector order.

labs.title: Thermocouple Calibration
labs.zhTitle: 热电偶定标与温度测量
labs.goal: Measure the temperature of the unknown bath X, in degrees Celsius. Submit {"action":"answer","T":number}.

labs.title: Thermocouple Step Time Constant
labs.goal: Measure the times to 50% and 90% of the indicated voltage step when the hot probe goes from ambient equilibrium to full immersion in bath H. Submit {"action":"answer","t50":number,"t90":number}, both in seconds.

labs.title: Single-Slit Laser Diffraction
labs.goal: Measure the slit width at the start of the experiment, in millimeters. Submit {"action":"answer","a":number}.

labs.title: Ultrasonic Speed of Sound
labs.goal: Measure the speed of sound in the unknown medium; submit {c} in m/s.

labs.title: Falling-Ball Stokes Viscosity
labs.goal: Measure the liquid's dynamic viscosity, in Pa·s. Submit {"action":"answer","eta":number}.

labs.title: Dual-Sphere Viscosity & Density
labs.zhTitle: 落球法测液体黏度与密度
labs.goal: Measure the dynamic viscosity and density of the liquid. Submit {"action":"answer","eta":number,"rho":number}, in Pa·s and kg/m³ respectively.

labs.title: Electrostatic Field Mapping
labs.goal: Measure the electric-field components at P under the voltage marked beside P. Submit {"action":"answer","Ex":number,"Ey":number} in V/m.

labs.title: Air Track Inertial Mass
labs.goal: Measure the mass of glider X, in kilograms. Submit {"action":"answer","m":number}.

labs.title: Air Track Multi-Load Dynamics
labs.zhTitle: 气垫导轨多载荷质量与重力测量
labs.goal: Measure the glider mass m in kg and local gravitational acceleration g in m/s². Submit {"action":"answer","m":number,"g":number}.

labs.title: Standing-Wave String Density
labs.goal: Measure the linear mass density of the string, in kg/m. Submit {"action":"answer","mu":number}.

labs.title: Stiff String Bending Rigidity
labs.zhTitle: 驻波法测刚性弦的线密度与抗弯刚度
labs.goal: Measure the linear density and flexural rigidity of the test filament. Submit {"action":"answer","mu":number,"B":number} in kg/m and N·m² respectively.

labs.title: Metal Specific Heat Calorimetry
labs.goal: Measure the specific heat capacity of specimen X, in J/(kg K). Submit {"action":"answer","c":number}.

labs.title: Hall Effect Carrier Concentration
labs.zhTitle: 霍尔效应测磁场与载流子浓度
labs.goal: Measure the magnetic-field magnitude B at P under the marked excitation condition and the carrier concentration n of sample X. Submit {"action":"answer","B":tesla,"n":per_cubic_metre}.

labs.title: Solenoid Axial Field Gradient
labs.zhTitle: 霍尔探头测轴向磁场梯度
labs.goal: At +1.500 A in opposing-coil mode, measure the zero-field height z0 on the coil axis and the signed axial gradient G = dBz/dz at z0. Submit {"action":"answer","G":number,"z0":number}, in T/m and mm.

labs.title: Series RLC Resonance
labs.zhTitle: RLC 测电感与串联电阻
labs.goal: Measure the unknown coil's inductance L (H) and series resistance R (ohms); submit {L,R}.

labs.title: Dual-Trace Capacitor ESR
labs.zhTitle: 双踪法测电容与等效串联电阻
labs.goal: Measure the capacitance C (F) and equivalent series resistance ESR (ohms) of capacitor module X. Submit {"action":"answer","C":number,"ESR":number}.

labs.title: Dual-Coil Mutual Inductance
labs.goal: Measure the mutual inductance at the two stops A and B in mH. Submit {"action":"answer","A":number,"B":number}.

labs.title: Michelson Interferometer Wavelength
labs.zhTitle: 迈克尔逊干涉仪测波长
labs.goal: Measure the wavelength of the light source, in nm. Submit {"action":"answer","lambda":number}.

labs.title: Michelson Sodium Doublet
labs.zhTitle: 迈克耳孙干涉仪测双谱线间距
labs.goal: Measure the wavelength separation of the source’s two spectral lines in nm. Submit {"action":"answer","delta":number}.

labs.title: Michelson Spectral Linewidth
labs.zhTitle: 迈克尔逊干涉仪测单线谱宽
labs.goal: Measure the full width at half maximum of the source’s spectral line, in nm. Submit {"action":"answer","width":number}.

labs.title: Newton's Rings Curvature Radius
labs.goal: Measure the lens radius of curvature in meters. Submit {"action":"answer","R":number}.

labs.title: Newton's Rings Refractive Index
labs.goal: Measure the liquid refractive index and submit {"action":"answer","n":number}.

labs.title: Trifilar Pendulum Moment of Inertia
labs.goal: Measure specimen X's moment of inertia about its symmetry axis, in kg·m². Submit {"action":"answer","I":number}.

labs.title: Offset Mass Inertia Theorem
labs.zhTitle: 三线摆偏轴质量与惯量测量
labs.goal: Measure the mass m in kg and centroidal axial moment of inertia I in kg·m² of either identical specimen. Submit {"action":"answer","m":number,"I":number}.

labs.title: Torsion Pendulum Shear Modulus
labs.zhTitle: 扭摆测金属丝剪切模量
labs.goal: Measure the shear modulus of the wire in GPa and submit {"action":"answer","G":number}.

labs.title: Optical Lever Young's Modulus
labs.goal: Measure the Young modulus of specimen X. Submit {"action":"answer","E":number} in pascals.

labs.title: Steady-State Thermal Conductivity
labs.goal: Measure the thermal conductivity of sample X; submit {k} in W/(m K).

labs.title: Latent Heat & Melting Calorimetry
labs.zhTitle: 电加热量热法测熔点与熔化潜热
labs.goal: Measure the melting temperature and specific latent heat of fusion of specimen X. Submit {"action":"answer","Tm":number,"L":number}, in °C and J/kg respectively.

labs.title: Ferromagnetic Hysteresis Loop
labs.zhTitle: 磁滞回线测剩磁与矫顽力
labs.goal: Measure the sample's quasi-static major-loop remanence Br (T) and coercive field Hc (A/m); submit {Br,Hc}.

labs.title: Normal Zeeman Magnetic Splitting
labs.goal: Measure the magnetic-field magnitude at the lamp under the marked excitation condition. Submit {"action":"answer","B":tesla}.

labs.title: Franck-Hertz Excitation Energy
labs.goal: Measure the first excitation energy of gas X, in electronvolts. Submit {"action":"answer","E":number}.

labs.title: Gamma Attenuation Coefficient
labs.zhTitle: 放射性吸收测衰减系数
labs.goal: Measure the linear attenuation coefficient of material S, in m^-1. Submit {"action":"answer","mu":number}.

labs.title: Millikan Oil Drop Elementary Charge
labs.zhTitle: 模拟环境中油滴测基本电荷
labs.goal: Measure the elementary charge in this simulated environment, in coulombs. Submit {"action":"answer","e":number}.

labs.title: Grating Spectrometer Wavelength
labs.goal: Measure the wavelength of the monochromatic light and submit {lambda} in nm.

labs.title: Spectrometer Grating Pitch
labs.goal: Measure the grating period and submit {d} in micrometres.

labs.title: Photoelectric Planck's Constant
labs.zhTitle: 光电效应测普朗克常量与逸出功
labs.goal: In this simulated environment, measure the effective Planck constant h (J*s) and the photocathode work function phi (eV). Submit {"action":"answer","h":number,"phi":number}.

labs.title: Quarter-Wave Plate Retardance
labs.goal: Measure the normal-incidence retardance of plate X at the source wavelength; submit {delta} in degrees in [0,180].

labs.title: Polarized Beam Stokes Vector
labs.zhTitle: 测量光束的斯托克斯参数
labs.goal: Measure the normalized Stokes parameters of the emitted beam. Use time-averaged intensities and correlations in the transverse basis (e0,e1)=(+Y,−Z), with s1=(|E0|²−|E1|²)/S0, s2=2 Re(E0*E1)/S0, and s3=2 Im(E0*E1)/S0; * denotes complex conjugation of E0. Submit {"action":"answer","s1":number,"s2":number,"s3":number}.

labs.title: Anomalous Zeeman Charge-to-Mass
labs.zhTitle: 汞反常塞曼测电子荷质比
labs.goal: Measure the effective electron charge-to-mass ratio in this simulated environment. Submit {"action":"answer","em":C_per_kg}.

labs.title: Radioactive Isotope Half-Life
labs.goal: Measure the half-life of the source, in seconds. Submit {"action":"answer","T_half":number}.

labs.title: Solid Linear Thermal Expansion
labs.goal: Measure the specimen’s linear thermal expansion coefficient. Submit {"action":"answer","alpha":number} in units of 10⁻⁶/K.

labs.title: Capillary Rise Surface Tension
labs.goal: Measure the sample liquid’s surface tension. Submit {"action":"answer","sigma":number} in mN/m.

labs.title: Collision Restitution Coefficient
labs.zhTitle: 双滑块碰撞恢复系数测量
labs.goal: Measure the coefficient of restitution of the two carts. Submit {"action":"answer","e":number}, dimensionless.

labs.title: RC Step Transient Time Constant
labs.goal: Measure the capacitance of the sample. Submit {"action":"answer","C":number} in microfarads.

labs.title: Minimum Deviation Prism Index
labs.goal: Measure the prism’s refractive index at the supplied wavelength. Submit {"action":"answer","n":number}, dimensionless.

labs.title: Archimedes Buoyancy Density
labs.goal: Measure the densities of the solid specimen and the test liquid. Submit {"action":"answer","rhoSolid":number,"rhoLiquid":number} in kg/m³.

labs.title: Adiabatic Expansion Gamma Index
labs.goal: Measure the sample gas heat capacity ratio. Submit {"action":"answer","gamma":number}, dimensionless.

labs.title: Helmholtz Coil Turns Verification
labs.zhTitle: 亥姆霍兹线圈匝数测量
labs.goal: Measure the number of turns in each of the two identical coils. Submit {"action":"answer","N":number}, in turns per coil.

labs.title: Maxwell-Wien AC Bridge Inductance
labs.zhTitle: 交流电桥测电感及损耗
labs.goal: Measure the coil inductance and equivalent series resistance. Submit {"action":"answer","L":number,"R":number}, with L in mH and R in ohms.

labs.title: NTC Thermistor Beta Parameter
labs.zhTitle: 热敏电阻温度特性测量
labs.goal: Measure the thermistor beta and its resistance at 25 °C. Submit {"action":"answer","beta":number,"R25":number}, with beta in K and R25 in kΩ.

labs.title: Fresnel Biprism Interference
labs.goal: Measure the wavelength of the light source. Submit {"action":"answer","lambda":number} in nm.

labs.title: Abbe Refractometer Liquid Index
labs.zhTitle: 阿贝折射仪测液体折射率
labs.goal: Measure the refractive index of the liquid. Submit {"action":"answer","n":number}, dimensionless.

labs.title: Ultrasonic Doppler Velocity
labs.goal: Measure the sound speed of the medium. Submit {"action":"answer","c":number} in m/s.

labs.title: Electron Diffraction Bragg Lattice
labs.goal: Measure the two crystal plane spacings. Submit {"action":"answer","d1":number,"d2":number} in nm with d1 greater than d2.

labs.title: Heat Engine P-V Cycle Net Work
labs.goal: Measure the net work done by the gas per quasi-static Stirling cycle between 55 and 90 mL using the two reservoirs. Submit {"action":"answer","W":number} in joules.

labs.title: PN Diode Ideality I-V Curve
labs.goal: Measure the diode ideality factor and reverse saturation current. Submit {"action":"answer","eta":number,"Is":number} with Is in nA.

labs.title: Refracting Telescope Magnification
labs.goal: Measure the magnitude of the telescope angular magnification. Submit {"action":"answer","M":number}, dimensionless.

labs.title: Compound Microscope Magnification
labs.zhTitle: 复合显微镜角放大率测量
labs.goal: Measure the absolute angular magnification of the microscope relative to viewing from 250 mm. Submit {"action":"answer","M":number}, dimensionless.

labs.title: Ammeter-Voltmeter Shunt Design
labs.zhTitle: 表头参数测量与量程改装
labs.goal: Measure the movement’s coil resistance and full-scale current, then configure the meter for the indicated range. Submit {"action":"answer","Rg":number,"Ig":number,"Rx":number}, with Rg and Rx in ohms and Ig in µA.

labs.title: Giant Magnetoresistance Saturation
labs.zhTitle: 巨磁电阻比与饱和磁场测量
labs.goal: Measure the maximum giant magnetoresistance ratio (relative to the parallel-state resistance) and saturation field magnitude. Submit {"action":"answer","MR":number,"Bs":number}, with MR in percent and Bs in mT.

labs.title: Reversible Kater Pendulum Gravity
labs.goal: Measure the local gravitational acceleration using the reversible pendulum. Submit {"action":"answer","g":number} in m/s².

labs.title: Newton Cooling Specific Heat
labs.goal: Measure the specific heat capacity of the unknown metal sample. Submit {"action":"answer","c":number} in J/(kg·K).

labs.title: 4f Optical Spatial Filtering
labs.goal: Measure the spatial cutoff frequency of the installed low-pass filter along the displayed grating axis. Submit {"action":"answer","fc":number} in cycles/mm.

labs.title: Microwave Bragg Crystal Diffraction
labs.zhTitle: 微波布拉格衍射测晶面间距
labs.goal: Measure the plane spacing of the periodic specimen using microwave diffraction. Submit {"action":"answer","d":number} in mm.

labs.title: Continuous-Wave NMR Gyromagnetic Ratio
labs.zhTitle: 连续波核磁共振测旋磁比
labs.goal: Measure the magnitude of the sample gyromagnetic ratio in frequency units. Submit {"action":"answer","gamma":number} in MHz/T.

labs.title: Grating Monochromator Calibration
labs.zhTitle: 单色仪定标与未知光谱线波长测量
labs.goal: Use the reference source to calibrate the monochromator and measure the unknown emission wavelength. Submit {"action":"answer","lambda":number} in nm.
